short: Bounds on the two error terms in the congruence estimate

lean.name: Formalism.LFunctionChainParameters.LChain.BNBounds
lean.plain: Bounds on the two error terms in the congruence estimate
lean.note: The bracket estimates give separate upper bounds for the two size terms that enter the slope argument. The cap on $B_0$ scales with the number of infinite places and the number of levels, while the cap on $N_c$ also depends on the size of the thick set $T_2$.
